name: qiaomu-goal-meta-skill
description: Turn vague or complex Codex tasks into strong, copy-ready /goal commands with verification, constraints, boundaries, iteration policy, and pause conditions.

interface.shortDescription: Turn vague Codex work into a best-default /goal command.
interface.longDescription: Qiaomu Goal Meta Skill converts a vague or complex request into a paste-ready Codex /goal command with an outcome, verification evidence, constraints, write boundaries, iteration policy, completion evidence, and pause/block conditions. It favors conservative defaults, offers numbered choices when a decision matters, and mirrors the goal in both Chinese and English-compatible field labels.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use qiaomu-goal-meta-skill to turn this vague task into a strong Codex /goal command with verification, boundaries, and pause conditions.
